pages.name: power
pages.title: Power management and charging
notes: nPM1300: BUCK1 boots at 2.7V through R12; firmware must set/read back 3.3V before enabling peripherals.
BUCK2 boots at 3.3V through R102. Each BUCK is limited to 200mA; power budget remains an explicit gate.
LOADSW1 supplies radio. Unused LOADSW2 input grounded/output NC. Backlight boost uses AUX_3V3 directly with default-low EN.
BAT_NTC requires an actual pack thermistor. Charging remains disabled until validated battery/NTC configuration.
Raw battery, USB, Qi input and physical power-button connections are on subsequent interface sheets.

pages.name: secure
pages.title: Secure elements and local power control
notes: TROPIC01 strap states match the manufacturer mini-board reference. Its test and DNC pins are not exposed.
OPTIGA unused pins remain floating; exposed paddle is grounded per Infineon guidance.
Q2/Q4 use AOS AO3401A SOT-23 prototype power gates, replacing the reference PicoStar support FETs.
Gate controls are active LOW and must use open-drain MCU outputs. RC gates limit turn-on inrush.
Drive host buses inactive before power removal; verify no back-powering and startup timing on assembled boards.

pages.name: radio
pages.title: Untrusted Bluetooth radio and RF front end
notes: Radio is an untrusted ciphertext transport. No shared trusted SPI/I2C/audio/debug nets.
LDO reference used: DCC ball B6 NC; radio firmware MUST leave DC/DC disabled.
Antenna T values are evaluation-board starting values; new PCB needs VNA and radiated tests.
Pin P0.21 reset requires UICR configuration; J102 has no main-MCU debug connection.
HF crystal uses CL10pF and 16p load capacitors, adapting the CL8pF Nordic reference. Verify clock accuracy/drive over voltage and temperature.

pages.name: radio-interface
pages.title: Default-disabled radio signal boundary
notes: TI transceivers have fixed hardware direction per channel and Ioff/VCC isolation.
OE pullup keeps both bridges disabled while MCU pins reset. Firmware enables only after power/readback.
This limits connected signals and power-off paths; it is not a galvanic isolation or exploit-prevention proof.
UART accepts bounded ciphertext frames only. Treat all radio-originated UART/credit inputs as hostile.

pages.name: control
pages.title: MCU clocks and local recovery controls
notes: BOOT0 has a physical pulldown. Local update button is a GPIO, not a boot-ROM USB enable.
TPS3420 open-drain RST may share NRST with the external probe; PB2 grounded selects single-button operation.
Reset button held 7.5 seconds asserts NRST until release. nPM power button is separate.
Crystals match Safe 7 identifiers. Load values require oscillator-margin and drive-level bench verification.

pages.name: microsd
pages.title: Locally enabled offline-update card
notes: Card uses software SPI on dedicated MCU GPIO; no radio/shared trusted bus access.
Power and signal bridge default off. Enable card power, verify settle, then enable signals only in local update mode.
Reject unsigned, wrong-target and rollback images on the trusted MCU; card data remains untrusted.
LDO is specified for 500mA but thermal/current/battery limits and card peak current still require bench qualification.
Card-detect switch stays in trusted 3.3V domain; it is mechanically isolated from SD power.

pages.name: power-entry
pages.title: USB, battery and local power entry
notes: USB4125 has power/CC only: no USB data connection to trusted MCU. Power USB is for a trusted bench source.
USB/Qi Schottky OR prevents direct source paralleling; input allowance includes voltage drop, fuse derating and heat.
nPM1300 supplies CC pull-downs internally; do not add parallel 5.1k resistors.
External 10k NTC with configured beta must be thermally attached to the battery. Missing/invalid NTC must inhibit charging.
Battery is a protected external assembly. Verify actual connector polarity before power; no battery included in PCB assembly BOM.

pages.name: audio-codec
pages.title: Trusted full-duplex audio codec

parts.value: BAT54WS; DLDO to ALDO pop suppression

notes: TI SLOS602E pins/package; SLAA492A internal DLDO/ALDO sequence with DVDD-to-AVDD Schottky diode.
IOVDD uses VDD_3V3; LDOIN has a separate switched 500mA-capable regulator. LDO_SELECT high enables internal 1.72V DLDO; AVDD/DVDD are not tied to 3.3V.
Hold RESET low while rails settle; wait at least 1ms after reset before writes, enable ALDO at >=DLDO voltage, then ADC/DAC.
SAI1 AF13: PE2 MCLK_A, PE3 SD_B capture, PE4 FS_A, PE5 SCK_A, PE6 SD_A playback.
Audio I2C2 PF0/PF1 and SAI are connected only to the trusted MCU; no radio wires.

pages.name: headset
pages.title: Wired headset and physical microphone disconnect
notes: CTIA only: Tip L, ring1 R, ring2 GND, sleeve MIC. OMTP requires an external passive adapter.
Mute switch disconnects headset microphone and grounds codec-side input; bias is after the disconnect.
No built-in microphone or speaker. Headphone outputs are independently AC coupled; never short HPL/HPR together.
220u coupling and 10R series values are evaluated in SPICE; exact capacitor MPN and headset/audio quality need qualification.
ESD parts are protective design elements, not a claim of tested IEC immunity.

pages.name: display
pages.title: Trusted color display and touch
notes: Newhaven NHD-2.4-240320AF-CTXP-CTP: 3-wire, 9-bit SPI3; IM0/IM2 high. Unused WR/RD/DB grounded per module wiring diagram.
IOVDD/LCD/touch use trusted MCU rail; hold both resets low until firmware confirms 3.3V.
Touch uses I2C5 PD0/PD1 AF4, separate from power, audio and secure-element buses.
Connector equivalents are bottom-contact 40x0.5mm and 6x1.0mm. Verify actual flex thickness, pin-1 and bend clearance.
Display is a separately procured assembly, not an IC mounted by the board assembler.

pages.name: backlight
pages.title: 40mA current-regulated parallel backlight
notes: TPS61062 constant-current mode: ILED grounded, 0.5V / 12R = 41.7mA nominal total; tolerance minimum 40.0mA.
Four 200R / 0.25W ballast resistors share branch current; include zener-clamp and open-LED fault sensitivity.
Boost input is VSYS directly; its worst-case current exceeds the PMIC load-switch 100mA rating. AUX buck budget remains a gate.
PWM at <=1kHz, default-low EN. Initial total backlight current is approximately 42mA.
6.2V zener provides alternate feedback path on open load; output capacitor is rated 50V for device OVP.
YZF land-pattern geometry still needs exact manufacturer package-drawing review; do not release fabrication.
Input is raw VSYS (2.7-6V driver range), with full operation gated at VSYS >=3.6V pending bench qualification; do not use the MCU/AUX buck for boost input.

pages.name: haptic
pages.title: Haptic feedback driver
notes: DRV2624 9-ball YFF map and 0.225mm pad / 0.4mm pitch from TI SLOS893D package drawing.
Actuator is an external LRA assembly. Its exact MPN, rated drive and auto-calibration settings remain qualification gates.
NRST defaults low; no startup vibration. Use I2C address 0x5A on trusted power-control bus.

pages.name: qi
pages.title: Qi receiver and isolated power-control interface
notes: ST DS14078 Rev1 Table37 wearable reference; catalogue coil 760308101219 (11.8uH), 247n series, 1n parallel.
Qi I2C is software-driven on PD3/PD4, physically separate from PMIC/secure-element buses. Bound every transaction and timeout.
Configure and read back 5.0V RX output; no reverse-transmit mode. nPM1300 input OVP rejects excessive output voltage.
See Qi sensing/control sheet for separate control bus, thermistor and ASK filter.
Coil/charger/metal-stack tuning, FOD, thermal, surge and layout qualification are still required.

pages.name: qi-control
pages.title: Qi sensing, ASK detector and host disable
notes: Qi control bus is separate from PMIC and secure-element buses; bound transactions and timeouts.
NTC must be attached to the coil. Divider and actual thermal cutoff must be bench-qualified.
Two-FET ENB circuit defaults to autonomous startup and avoids driving an unpowered chip from the MCU rail.
ASK detector follows ST DS14078 Figure15; 1N4148WS substitutes the reference signal diode and needs bench comparison.

pages.name: nfc
pages.title: Optional locally enabled NFC transceiver
notes: ST25R3916B-BWLT retains Safe7 core part. Supplies/decoupling and crystal follow pinned TS7 sheet10 and ST DS13541.
Dedicated VSYS LDO avoids overloading the MCU 200mA buck. Default power off and signal bridge disabled.
No NFC use during calls or charging tests until RF/thermal/current limits and trusted local pairing are defined.
IRQ is active HIGH. TAD/clock/automatic-tuning outputs unused. Fixed matching network is on the following sheet.
NFC transport alone does not authenticate a contact; device signatures/pinned contacts and local confirmation remain mandatory.

pages.name: nfc-matching
pages.title: Differential NFC matching and antenna interface
notes: Matching topology/starting values from Safe7 TS7 revD sheet10. They are NOT validated for a replacement antenna.
Pulse W7001 is a catalogue antenna candidate; confirm supply, dimensions, inductance/Q and cable before release.
Require VNA matching, field strength, coexistence, ferrite/metal-stack and temperature tests on the actual assembly.
Keep NFC disabled until antenna/current/thermal and pairing-protocol qualification passes.

pages.name: nfc-interface
pages.title: Default-disabled NFC signal boundary
notes: SPI1 PA5/PA6/PA7, GPIO PA4 CS, PG9 active-high IRQ; no shared radio, secure-element or PMIC bus.
Strapped directions and default-high OE keep NFC signals disconnected through reset and power changes.
Check VCC isolation, power-off leakage and interrupt-flood bounds on the assembled prototype.

pages.name: audio-power
pages.title: Dedicated switched audio supply
notes: Do not place the codec analog/headphone supply on the 200mA MCU buck: TI calls for 150mA analog capability plus digital demand.
PB10 enable has a 100k pulldown. IOVDD must be valid before LDOIN; hold audio RESET and clocks low during startup.
After MCU rail/configuration readback, enable LDOIN; verify rail and internal DLDO, then release RESET and wait >=1ms before writes.
R609 is a removable current-measurement link. VSYS dropout and output discharge/restart require bench tests.
DRV WSON thermal pad must connect to ground/copper heat spreading; 500mA rating is not a continuous thermal allocation.
The TLV755 input/output capacitors must retain >0.47uF effective capacitance after DC bias, tolerance and temperature.
